web_browser_capabilities_cookies.summary: Warn visitors whose browser blocks cookies.
web_browser_capabilities_cookies.usage: When Yes, customers whose browser has cookies disabled are shown a notice, since the store needs cookies to work.

web_browser_capabilities_javascript.summary: Warn visitors whose browser has JavaScript off.
web_browser_capabilities_javascript.usage: When Yes, a notice is shown to customers with JavaScript disabled.

web_browser_capabilities_local_storage.summary: Warn visitors whose browser blocks local storage.
web_browser_capabilities_local_storage.usage: When Yes, a notice is shown to customers whose browser has local storage disabled.

web_cookie_cookie_domain.summary: The domain cookies are set for.
web_cookie_cookie_domain.usage: The domain used when setting cookies. Leave blank to use the current domain, or set it (e.g. .example.com) to share cookies across subdomains.

web_cookie_cookie_httponly.usage: When Yes, cookies cannot be read by JavaScript, which protects them from theft. Do not set to No — it weakens security.

web_cookie_cookie_lifetime.usage: The lifetime of session and other cookies, in seconds.

web_cookie_cookie_path.summary: The path cookies are scoped to.
web_cookie_cookie_path.usage: The URL path cookies apply to. Use / for the whole site, or a subpath to limit them.

web_cookie_cookie_restriction.usage: When Yes, Cookie Restriction Mode asks visitors to consent before non-essential cookies are set, for privacy compliance.

web_default_cms_home_page.summary: The CMS page used as the storefront home page.
web_default_cms_home_page.usage: Which CMS page is shown at the store's root URL.

web_default_cms_no_cookies.summary: The CMS page shown when cookies are disabled.
web_default_cms_no_cookies.usage: Which CMS page is displayed to visitors whose browser blocks cookies.

web_default_cms_no_route.summary: The CMS page shown for 404 (not found).
web_default_cms_no_route.usage: Which CMS page is displayed when a requested URL doesn't exist.

web_default_front.summary: The default route loaded at the store root.
web_default_front.usage: The action path loaded at the store root (default cms), before the home page resolves.

web_default_no_route.summary: The route that handles not-found URLs.
web_default_no_route.usage: The action path (for example cms/noroute/index) used when no route matches a request.

web_default_show_cms_breadcrumbs.usage: When Yes, breadcrumb navigation is shown on CMS pages.

web_default_layouts_default_category_lay.summary: The default page layout for category pages.
web_default_layouts_default_category_lay.usage: The column layout applied to category pages unless an individual category overrides it.

web_default_layouts_default_cms_layout.summary: The default page layout for CMS pages.
web_default_layouts_default_cms_layout.usage: The column layout applied to CMS pages unless an individual page overrides it.

web_default_layouts_default_product_layo.summary: The default page layout for product pages.
web_default_layouts_default_product_layo.usage: The column layout applied to product pages unless an individual product overrides it.

web_secure_base_url.usage: The root HTTPS URL of the store. Specify a full URL or a placeholder such as {{base_url}}.

web_secure_base_link_url.summary: The secure base URL used for links.
web_secure_base_link_url.usage: The HTTPS base used when building links. May start with {{secure_base_url}} or {{unsecure_base_url}}.

web_secure_base_media_url.summary: The secure base URL for media files.
web_secure_base_media_url.usage: The HTTPS base for product and other media. Leave empty to derive it from the secure base URL.

web_secure_base_static_url.summary: The secure base URL for static files.
web_secure_base_static_url.usage: The HTTPS base for compiled static assets (CSS/JS). Leave empty to derive it from the secure base URL.

web_secure_use_in_frontend.usage: When Yes, secure (HTTPS) URLs are used on the storefront.

web_secure_use_in_adminhtml.usage: When Yes, secure (HTTPS) URLs are used in the admin.

web_secure_enable_hsts.usage: When Yes, the store sends HTTP Strict Transport Security, telling browsers to always use HTTPS. Make sure HTTPS works everywhere first.

web_secure_enable_upgrade_insecure.usage: When Yes, the store asks browsers to automatically load any HTTP resources over HTTPS instead.

web_secure_offloader_header.summary: Header used to detect SSL termination upstream.
web_secure_offloader_header.usage: The request header a load balancer or proxy sets to signal that SSL was terminated before Magento (for example X-Forwarded-Proto).

web_seo_use_rewrites.usage: When Yes, server rewrites remove index.php from URLs. Requires the web server to support URL rewrites.

web_session_use_http_user_agent.summary: Validate the session against the User-Agent.
web_session_use_http_user_agent.usage: When Yes, a session is tied to the browser's User-Agent, adding a check against session hijacking.

web_session_use_http_via.summary: Validate the session against the Via header.
web_session_use_http_via.usage: When Yes, the Via header is included in session validation. May cause problems behind some proxies.

web_session_use_http_x_forwarded_for.usage: When Yes, the X-Forwarded-For header is included in session validation. May cause problems behind some proxies or CDNs.

web_session_use_remote_addr.summary: Validate the session against the client IP.
web_session_use_remote_addr.usage: When Yes, a session is tied to the client's IP address. May break for users whose IP changes mid-session.

web_unsecure_base_url.usage: The root URL of the store. Specify a full URL or a placeholder such as {{base_url}}.

web_unsecure_base_link_url.summary: The base URL used for links.
web_unsecure_base_link_url.usage: The base used when building links. May start with {{unsecure_base_url}}.

web_unsecure_base_media_url.summary: The base URL for media files.
web_unsecure_base_media_url.usage: The base for product and other media. Leave empty to derive it from the base URL.

web_unsecure_base_static_url.summary: The base URL for static files.
web_unsecure_base_static_url.usage: The base for compiled static assets (CSS/JS). Leave empty to derive it from the base URL.

web_url_catalog_media_url_format.summary: How catalog image URLs are formed.
web_url_catalog_media_url_format.usage: Whether product image variants are served via query parameters (CDN-friendly) or as uniquely hashed files (legacy mode).

web_url_redirect_to_base.summary: Redirect unrecognized hosts to the base URL.
web_url_redirect_to_base.usage: Whether requests to a non-base host are redirected to the configured base URL, and with which redirect code.

web_url_use_store.summary: Put the store code in URLs.
web_url_use_store.usage: When Yes, the store code is added to URLs (for example /en/). Warning: can cause issues in some setups.
